appearance_facts.fact: The chart title 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' is centered at the top of the image.
The 'Hydroelectric (10%)' slice is the smallest wedge, colored orange-red, located in the top-right quadrant of the pie chart.
The 'Nuclear (45%)' slice is the largest wedge, colored pale yellow, located in the top-left quadrant of the pie chart.
The 'Fossil Fuels (30%)' slice is a medium-sized wedge, colored dark red, located in the bottom-left quadrant of the pie chart.
The 'Renewables (15%)' slice is a medium-sized wedge, colored orange, located in the bottom-right quadrant of the pie chart.
Each slice contains white text with the source name and its percentage value.

printed_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
The bottom-left slice is labeled 'Fossil Fuels (30%)'.

public_definitions: The task requires identifying the largest global energy consumption source category from the provided pie chart.
The largest category is defined by the slice with the highest percentage value.
The routing decision must be based solely on the visual data in the chart, not on external knowledge or assumptions.
The 'Priority source monitoring route' field must be set to the option corresponding to the largest category.
The options are: 'Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring', 'Route Hydroelectric to priority source monitoring', 'Keep Fossil Fuels on routine source monitoring'.
